subject.title: fix: remove legacy profile details route

question: Should old `/profile/details` and localized detail URLs intentionally 404 after this cleanup, or should they redirect to `/profile/settings` for bookmarked users?
rationale: The code deletion is coherent, but changing an existing reachable profile URL into a 404 is a user-visible compatibility decision that maintainers should explicitly accept before merge.

options.title: Accept the intentional 404
options.body: Merge after real behavior proof if the team wants the legacy URL fully removed as requested by the linked issue.

options.title: Redirect to settings
options.body: Keep the duplicate form deleted but add redirects from the old localized URLs to `/profile/settings` to preserve bookmarked entry points.

options.title: Pause route removal
options.body: Hold the PR if profile route compatibility needs product review beyond the linked issue's cleanup decision.

recommendation.title: Accept the intentional 404
recommendation.body: Merge after real behavior proof if the team wants the legacy URL fully removed as requested by the linked issue.
